n9b8dd384fea.s: The ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds under Startup India is managed by:
n9b8dd384fea.x: Startup India includes a ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds managed by SIDBI.

ndeb9771b65f.s: Stand-Up India primarily provides bank loans to:
ndeb9771b65f.x: Stand-Up India provides bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.

n69b84cfde4f.s: In the ZED certification for MSMEs, ZED stands for:
n69b84cfde4f.x: ZED stands for Zero Defect Zero Effect and certifies MSMEs for quality and low environmental impact.

nf5e90995716.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bharatmala – Highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads
nf5e90995716.x: Bharatmala concerns highways, including economic corridors and border and coastal roads; Sagarmala concerns port-led development.

n84cddd95b3a.s:
Consider the following about Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFCs):
1. The Eastern DFC runs Ludhiana–Sonnagar/Dankuni and the Western DFC Dadri–JNPT.
2. DFCs are built by NHAI.
Which of the above is/are correct?
n84cddd95b3a.x: Statement 1 is correct. DFCs are built by DFCCIL, not NHAI (NHAI builds Bharatmala highways).

nc2590a6450e.s: UJALA, under which EESL supplies LED bulbs and energy-efficient appliances, is associated with the:
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
nc2590a6450e.x: UJALA is associated with the Ministry of Power and promotes LED bulbs and energy-efficient appliances through EESL.

nf7f219bff0e.s: BharatNet aims to provide optical-fibre broadband connectivity to all:
nf7f219bff0e.x: BharatNet aims to provide optical-fibre broadband connectivity to all gram panchayats.

n1e7ed5b8f1b.s: NICDC, functioning under DPIIT, is associated with:
o: Industrial corridors and smart industrial cities
n1e7ed5b8f1b.x: NICDC is associated with industrial corridors and smart industrial cities under DPIIT.

na07b1b5f245.s: India's renewable energy capacity grew between 2015 and 2025 from approximately:
na07b1b5f245.x: Renewable capacity grew from about 40 GW in 2015 to about 260 GW in 2025.

n87c5e165567.s: Under Auto Driver Sevalo, which succeeded YSR Vahana Mitra, the annual assistance to self-owned auto owners changed from:
n87c5e165567.x: YSR Vahana Mitra gave ₹10,000 a year to self-owned auto/taxi drivers; Auto Driver Sevalo gives ₹15,000 a year to owners of self-owned autos.

n74789913c93.s: Talliki Vandanam of Andhra Pradesh replaced which earlier scheme?
n74789913c93.x: Talliki Vandanam replaced Jagananna Amma Vodi, which paid ₹15,000 a year to the mother/guardian of a poor child sent to school. Vidya Deevena is fee reimbursement; Aasara repaid SHG loans.

n9a4c3241697.s: Jagananna Chedodu provided ₹10,000 a year to which group owning shops?
o: Self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
n9a4c3241697.x: Jagananna Chedodu provides ₹10,000 per year to self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins with shops.

n0d6d55d587b.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Spandana grievance portal is now referred to as:
n0d6d55d587b.x: Spandana was the grievance portal and is now referred to as PGRS.

nfbc5d16bdbe.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Vahana Mitra – ₹10,000 a year to auto and taxi owner-drivers
Rythu Bharosa – ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers
Matsyakara Bharosa – Support to marine fishermen during the fishing ban
Nethanna Nestham – ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers owning looms
nfbc5d16bdbe.x: ₹24,000 a year to handloom weavers is Nethanna Nestham, not Rythu Bharosa, which is a farmer scheme.

n67fef14853d.s: The Matsyakara Bharosa benefit to marine fishermen during the fishing ban was raised from:
n67fef14853d.x: The benefit under Matsyakara Bharosa was raised from ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per family.

n90a024af37b.s: The AP Chief Minister's approach to welfare delivery treats ____ as the basic unit.
n90a024af37b.x: The Chief Minister stated that the family should be the unit for welfare, including family mapping before sanctioning new pensions.

naa9ecb212d4.s: In Andhra Pradesh, persons with 40% or more disability receive a monthly pension of:
naa9ecb212d4.x: Persons with 40% or more disability receive ₹6,000 per month without an age limit; ₹10,000 is for thalassaemia and similar patients.

n38b9e0b131c.s: The nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions in Andhra Pradesh is:
n38b9e0b131c.x: SERP is the nodal agency for NTR Bharosa pensions.

nf832ad4773c.s: Direct Benefit Transfer through the JAM trinity mainly helps to reduce:
nf832ad4773c.x: DBT through the JAM trinity helps reduce ghost beneficiaries and middlemen in welfare delivery.

n6c6b331bef4.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the 104 service provides:
o: Mobile medical units with fixed-day village health services
n6c6b331bef4.x: 104 operates mobile medical units with fixed-day village health services, whereas 108 is the emergency ambulance service.

n0e7f851a4e2.s: Under AP's Universal Health Policy, poor persons receive treatment up to ____ through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.
n0e7f851a4e2.x: Every citizen gets free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh, while poor persons get treatment up to ₹25 lakh through the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.

n7720308936b.s: The stated proposal for ration rice distribution in Andhra Pradesh is:
o: 5 kg per family, irrespective of size
5 kg per family member, treating the family as the unit
10 kg per family, irrespective of size
n7720308936b.x: The proposal is 5 kg of rice for every family member, with the family treated as the unit.

n28e3b565b9a.s: Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to:
o: Tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas
n28e3b565b9a.x: Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas.

nc0c91c046c7.s: Sampoorna Poshana (Poshana Plus) in Andhra Pradesh is associated with:
o: Richer take-home rations through Anganwadi Centres
nc0c91c046c7.x: Sampoorna Poshana/Poshana Plus provides richer take-home rations through Anganwadi Centres.

n9591692b656.s: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 proposed completing investigation and trial in sexual offences against women within:
n9591692b656.x: The Disha Bill proposed investigation within 7 days and trial within 14 days, 21 days in all.

nf05af6e82bc.s: Which facility provides police, medical, legal, counselling and shelter support to women facing violence under one roof?
nf05af6e82bc.x: One Stop Centres provide police, medical, legal, counselling and shelter support to women facing violence at one place.

n723cbd2e8bd.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka – Muslim brides only
Shaadi Tohfa – SC and ST brides only
Dulhan – Muslim brides, introduced in April 2015
n723cbd2e8bd.x: Dulhan was for Muslim brides and began in April 2015. Chandranna Pelli Kanuka and YSR Kalyanamasthu covered SC, ST, BC, minorities and disabled; Shaadi Tohfa was for Muslims.

n3b2f2076b5e.s: Village and Ward Secretariats were introduced in Andhra Pradesh in:
n3b2f2076b5e.x: Village and Ward Secretariats were introduced in 2019, with more than 10,000 secretariats offering over 500 services.

n1970dae8bcc.s: Which of the following correctly states the coverage of SERP and MEPMA?
o: SERP – 2.74 lakh rural women; MEPMA – 84.47 lakh urban SHGs
SERP – 84.47 lakh urban women; MEPMA – 2.74 lakh rural SHGs
SERP – 84.47 lakh rural women; MEPMA – 2.74 lakh urban SHGs
SERP – 2.74 lakh rural SHGs; MEPMA – 84.47 lakh urban women
n1970dae8bcc.x: SERP works with 84.47 lakh rural women, while MEPMA covers 2.74 lakh urban SHGs.

n800de00dcdb.s: Under AP's current housing policy, an eligible homeless household gets a house site of:
n800de00dcdb.x: The policy provides house sites of 3 cents in rural areas and 2 cents in urban areas for every eligible homeless household by 2029.

n3db9472f0f9.s: Navaratnalu, the previous AP government's welfare package, was funded from:
n3db9472f0f9.x: Navaratnalu was the previous government's welfare package and was funded from revenue expenditure.

nc9c6590471a.s: Fiscal-strain concerns over AP's welfare commitments arise with State debt at about ____ of GSDP.
nc9c6590471a.x: The stated concern is fiscal strain in the context of debt of about 36% of GSDP.

n59c4baa420a.s:
Consider the following about YSR Zero Interest Crop Loans:
1. The scheme was launched on 20 April 2021.
2. Crop loans up to ₹1 lakh become interest-free if repaid on time.
3. The benefit applies only to loans exceeding ₹1 lakh.
Which of the above are correct?
n59c4baa420a.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the scheme covers crop loans up to ₹1 lakh repaid on time, so statement 3 is false.

n40aefd9c34c.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. YSR Jala Kala – Free borewells for small and marginal farmers
2. Rythu Bharosa Kendras – District offices only for sanctioning crop loans
3. e-Crop – Digital booking of the crop on every field each season
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n40aefd9c34c.x: YSR Jala Kala gives free borewells and e-Crop digitally books every field's crop each season. RBKs are village one-stop centres, not district loan offices.

nd2832a7b7aa.s: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for Andhra Pradesh's:
nd2832a7b7aa.x: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for the 2024–29 policies and industrial corridors in Andhra Pradesh.

nb858bf134bc.s: Which of the following pairs of AP 4.0 policies and headline goals is correctly matched?
o: Food Processing Policy 4.0 – One Family, One Entrepreneur
MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0 – Investment target of ₹30 lakh crore
Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 – USD 50 billion production, USD 10 billion investment and five lakh jobs
Industrial Development Policy 4.0 – Cold chains and mega food parks
nb858bf134bc.x: The Electronics policy carries the USD 50 billion production goal. One Family, One Entrepreneur is the MSME policy, the ₹30 lakh crore target is the Industrial policy, and cold chains belong to Food Processing.

n8b8e90e67d9.s:
Consider the following about the energy goal of Swarna Andhra@2047:
1. Andhra Pradesh aims at net zero emissions by 2047.
2. The goal is linked with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25.
3. The net-zero target year is 2035.
Which of the above are correct?
n8b8e90e67d9.x: The net-zero target is 2047 and is tied to the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25; the target year is not 2035.

nec4f5932064.s: Under AP's industrial policy framework, a 'large project' has fixed capital investment of:
o: Above ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore
Above ₹250 crore and up to ₹501 crore
nec4f5932064.x: A large project has fixed capital investment above ₹501 crore and up to ₹1,000 crore; a mega project is linked with 2,000 or more direct jobs.

n00331f0b353.s: The AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020 provides for regulation of:
n00331f0b353.x: The Aqua Authority regulates aqua farms, aquaculture seed and aquaculture feed under the 2020 Act.

n914ac805430.s: Which is the nodal agency for industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities in Andhra Pradesh?
n914ac805430.x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and provides plug-and-play industrial infrastructure.

nc32fac22a83.s: AP FiberNet, launched in 2017, provides homes and offices with low-cost:
nc32fac22a83.x: AP FiberNet is a fibre grid launched in 2017 to provide low-cost broadband, television and telephone services to homes and offices.

n31b04880408.s: Which AP system monitors services and grievances in real time from a command centre at the Secretariat?
n31b04880408.x: Real Time Governance operates through a command centre at the Secretariat for real-time monitoring of services and grievances.

n891a6766ab9.s: The Gandhian Plan of 1944 is associated with:
n891a6766ab9.x: The Gandhian Plan of 1944 is associated with S. N. Agarwal.

nb53bf655042.s: In a mixed economy, the State regulates the private sector mainly through:
nb53bf655042.x: The State regulates the private sector in a mixed economy through taxation, subsidies and credit.

n62e3761a1ac.s: In 1951, agriculture employed about what share of India's workforce?
n62e3761a1ac.x: Agriculture was the main livelihood at Independence and employed about 72 per cent of the workforce in 1951.

n152018dc80b.s: The first National Income Committee (1951) estimated India's per capita income in 1948-49 at about:
n152018dc80b.x: The Committee put national income in 1948-49 at Rs 8,710 crore and per capita income at Rs 225.

ncc4cf8e1800.s: A State's per capita income is calculated as:
o: GSDP divided by the number of households
ncc4cf8e1800.x: Per capita income is NSDP divided by population, a net figure; per capita GSDP is a gross figure.

nindian-economy-57-13.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Real estate is a tertiary activity.
2. Social work is a tertiary activity.
3. Industrial activity is a primary activity.
Which of the above are correct?
nindian-economy-57-13.x: Real estate and social work are tertiary services; industrial activity is secondary, not primary.

nindian-economy-57-14.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Textile manufacturing is a secondary activity.
2. Communication is a tertiary activity.
3. Mineral exploration is a secondary activity.
Which of the above are correct?
nindian-economy-57-14.x: Textile manufacturing is secondary and communication tertiary; mineral exploration is primary, not secondary.

nindian-economy-57-17.s: Which of the following is NOT a tertiary sector activity?
nindian-economy-57-17.x: Marketing, health and personal services are tertiary; weaving cloth is a secondary activity.

na1340938333.s: In the new series at current prices for 2024-25, which sector had the largest share in India's GVA?
na1340938333.x: In 2024-25 the tertiary sector accounted for 52.9 per cent, against 25.8 per cent for the secondary and 21.4 per cent for the primary sector.

nbaee7fb32a8.s: Work participation rates are higher in less developed States such as Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh mainly because:
o: Subsistence activities need greater participation in manual work
nbaee7fb32a8.x: Higher work participation in these States is associated with subsistence work and the need for manual labour, especially in rural activities.

ndd6553a8614.s: In India's middle path, the 'commanding heights' under State control referred to:
o: Consumer goods, retail trade and tourism
ndd6553a8614.x: India's middle path kept State control over the commanding heights, namely heavy industry, infrastructure and finance, while allowing a regulated private sector in consumer goods.

nb546e7f89d6.s: A common criticism of India's development is that its large GDP coexists with an HDI rank of about:
nb546e7f89d6.x: The criticism cites a large GDP alongside an HDI rank of 130, showing that economic size does not ensure equivalent human development.

n73fd8f0aba1.s: Which sector contributes the largest share of national income in India's mixed economy?
n73fd8f0aba1.x: Although India has both public and private sectors, the largest share of national income comes from the private sector.

n596415af2a6.s: The services sector's share of India's GVA rose from 51.9% in 2022-23 to ____ in 2025-26.
n596415af2a6.x: The services sector's share of GVA rose from 51.9% in 2022-23 to 54.3% in 2025-26.

ne3806a55b25.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, the apparent fall in manufacturing's nominal share of GVA is mainly due to:
o: A fall in real manufacturing output
A rise in imports of manufactures
ne3806a55b25.x: The Survey attributes the decline in manufacturing's nominal share to a relative-price effect; in real terms the share is stable at 17-18 per cent.

n0f21fc6afc4.s: Compared with India as a whole, Andhra Pradesh's economy has:
o: A farm share below the national share
An industrial share above 50 per cent
A services share of about 70 per cent
A farm share well above the national share
n0f21fc6afc4.x: Agriculture's share in Andhra Pradesh is well above India's, which is below 20 per cent; India's services share is about 54.3 per cent.

nd27a8269f68.s: In 2023-24, manufacturing employed about what share of India's workers?
nd27a8269f68.x: Manufacturing employed about 11.4% of workers in 2023-24: 1.9 crore organised and 3.3 crore unorganised workers.

n7a4ded7834d.s: Which of the following pairs of data and compiling institution is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: GDP and sectoral GVA – National Statistical Office
State GSDP – State Directorate of Economics and Statistics
ASI and ASUSE manufacturing components – State Directorate of Economics and Statistics
State sectoral GVA – State Directorate of Economics and Statistics
n7a4ded7834d.x: ASI and ASUSE manufacturing components are compiled by the NSO, not the State DES. GDP is compiled by the NSO and State GSDP/GVA by the State DES.

nb5682a5c150.s: The changing relative shares of the primary, secondary and tertiary sectors in India's national income indicate:
nb5682a5c150.x: A structural change in the composition of national income has occurred, reflected in the changing importance of the three sectors.

nd141afd49fe.s: International bodies such as the WTO classify services using the:
nd141afd49fe.x: International bodies such as the WTO use the United Nations Central Product Classification (UNCPC) for services.

ncaff99b961e.s: A Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) reading above 50 generally indicates:
ncaff99b961e.x: A PMI reading above 50 indicates expansion; below 50 indicates contraction.

nbbdd0aa94ad.s: The Index of Services Production (ISP) is designed as the services counterpart of the:
nbbdd0aa94ad.x: The ISP is designed as the services counterpart of the Index of Industrial Production.

n61a8af8080c.s: The number of Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India has risen to over:
n61a8af8080c.x: GCCs now number over 1,800, and their forex earnings help cushion the merchandise trade deficit.

nc375d0cec9c.s: The Software Export Scheme of 1972 permitted:
o: Import of computers against an export obligation
Tax exemption for software units without any export condition
Reservation of computer production for public-sector firms
Duty-free software imports for domestic use
nc375d0cec9c.x: The Software Export Scheme of 1972 permitted computers to be imported against an export obligation.

ne4c9d879456.s: As per NASSCOM's FY2025 data, direct employment in India's IT-BPM industry was about:
ne4c9d879456.x: NASSCOM estimated about 58 lakh (5.8 million) direct jobs in the IT-BPM industry in FY2025.

nf7cf9efbdb5.s: Employment in India's IT-BPM sector is mainly:
o: Organised, with contracts and social security
nf7cf9efbdb5.x: IT-BPM employment is mostly organised-sector work with contracts and social security, with a relatively high share of women.

n6017dae18fd.s: The main destinations of India's IT-BPM exports are:
n6017dae18fd.x: India's IT-BPM exports mainly go to the USA and Europe, making the sector sensitive to their visa regimes and client spending.

n53bb961514a.s: Bengaluru alone accounts for about what share of India's IT exports?
n53bb961514a.x: Bengaluru alone accounts for about 38 per cent of IT exports, while seven cities together account for 70 per cent.

nf94d81822bb.s: High-end services such as IT can grow rapidly in GVA while creating few jobs because they are:
nf94d81822bb.x: High-end services record fast GVA growth but limited job creation because they are skill-intensive and automated.

n5161c9922fc.s: Which segment of the IT-BPM industry is most exposed to automation and generative AI?
n5161c9922fc.x: Routine ITES/BPM work is identified as the segment most exposed to automation and generative AI.

n069b877ba00.s: As India's largest services forex earner, software and computer services help the balance of payments by:
n069b877ba00.x: Software and computer services are India's largest services export and help offset the merchandise trade deficit.

ne8ad4c91b44.s: Which body, established in 1991, was India's first export-park model for software?
ne8ad4c91b44.x: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), set up in 1991, was India's first export-park model for software.

n502804033e0.s: In FY25, which business overtook motor insurance as India's leading non-life insurance segment?
n502804033e0.x: In FY25, when premium income was Rs 11.9 lakh crore, health insurance overtook motor as the leading non-life business.

nd3d0a2c7403.s: Under Section 6 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, banks may undertake para-banking activities with the approval of:
nd3d0a2c7403.x: Section 6 permits banks to undertake specified para-banking activities with RBI approval.

nb5b1f85a87c.s: The number of male workers in India as per Census 2011 was about:
nb5b1f85a87c.x: Census 2011 recorded about 332 million male workers.

naba1f22adb3.x: Census 2011 was the 15th Census since 1872 and the 7th after Independence.

nf2808fdf23d.s: A factory using power falls in the organised manufacturing sector if it employs at least:
nf2808fdf23d.x: Organised manufacturing covers registered factories with 10 or more workers using power (20 or more without power).

naf1802d8998.s: 'Jobless growth' refers to a situation in which:
o: Output grows without a matching rise in quality employment
Employment shifts from agriculture to services
naf1802d8998.x: Jobless growth is output growth not matched by adequate employment growth, especially in formal, quality jobs.

n5426208d0e9.s: Jobless growth became especially evident in India during the:
n5426208d0e9.x: In the late 1990s, employment growth fell to early-plan levels even while GDP kept growing.

n7aab9504ae1.s: 'Formal informality' refers to new EPFO 'formal' jobs that are often:
n7aab9504ae1.x: 'Formal informality' describes EPFO-recorded formal jobs that may still be short-term, low-wage or contractual.

n74a8beff264.s: India's social-protection coverage rose from 19% in 2015 to ____ in 2025, placing it second after China.
n74a8beff264.x: Social-protection coverage rose from 19% in 2015 to 64.3% in 2025, ranking India second after China.

nc5b0d7437a6.s: The unorganised (informal) sector mainly consists of:
o: Registered factories with 10 or more workers using power
Small, scattered units largely outside government control and monitoring
Large units monitored by government agencies
nc5b0d7437a6.x: The unorganised sector consists largely of small, scattered units outside effective government control, taxation and monitoring.

na7cfe4d117d.s: In the Harrod-Domar model, with the savings rate unchanged, a rise in the capital-output ratio will:
o: First raise and then lower the growth rate
na7cfe4d117d.x: Since g = s/k, a higher capital-output ratio lowers growth when the savings rate is unchanged.

nef3bd9f06e0.s: In the view that treats 1991 as the decisive turning point, the debt-fuelled growth phase of the 1980s ended in the:
nef3bd9f06e0.x: The 1980s growth phase is seen as debt-fuelled and unstable, ending in the 1991 crisis, after which sustained high growth began.

nindian-economy-4-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-economy-4-13.x: SIDBI was set up in 1990. DWCRA dates from 1982, JRY from 1989 and the New Economic Policy from 1991.

n01ae045509c.s: During the 1991 balance-of-payments crisis, India's foreign exchange reserves covered imports for only about:
n01ae045509c.x: Reserves covered only about two weeks of imports, and the fiscal deficit had reached 8.4% in 1990; the crisis led to the July 1991 reforms.

n1f38582309e.s: India's principal policy orientation between 1947 and 1991 was:
o: Free trade with minimal state intervention
Import substitution with a large public-sector role
n1f38582309e.x: The policy orientation was import substitution backed by state planning and public investment, not export promotion or deregulation.

nbcbd726de42.s: In the context of economic planning, the Karachi Resolution of 1931 advocated:
o: Free trade with no state ownership
Economic freedom and state ownership of key industries
nbcbd726de42.x: The 1931 Karachi Resolution supported economic freedom and state ownership of key industries.

n6e1c7f8e05d.s:
Consider the following pairs about the Planning Commission:
1. First Deputy Chairman – Gulzarilal Nanda
2. Last Deputy Chairman – M.S. Ahluwalia
3. Last Five-Year Plan – Eleventh Plan
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
n6e1c7f8e05d.x: Gulzarilal Nanda was the first and M.S. Ahluwalia the last Deputy Chairman; the last Plan was the Twelfth (2012-17), not the Eleventh.

n0c681a8762e.s:
Consider the following about the National Development Council:
1. It approved the draft Five-Year Plans.
2. It was intended to meet at least twice a year.
3. It continues to be the active coordinating body today.
Which of the above are correct?
n0c681a8762e.x: The NDC approved draft Plans and was meant to meet at least twice a year; it is now inactive, its role having passed to NITI Aayog's Governing Council.

nindian-economy-23-7.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Planning Commission – Tax devolution and grants
Finance Commission – Planning and resource allocation
Finance Commission – Tax devolution and grants
National Development Council – Tax devolution and grants
nindian-economy-23-7.x: The Finance Commission handles tax sharing and grants; the Planning Commission handled planning and resource allocation.

nb0dec4b7ecc.s: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?
nb0dec4b7ecc.x: Gulzarilal Nanda was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission; M.S. Ahluwalia was the last.

n7e1e6d5dc49.s: Which of the following pairs of Plan and main thrust is correctly matched?
o: First Plan – Removal of poverty and self-reliance
Third Plan – Agriculture, irrigation and power
Second Plan – Rapid industrialisation and socialistic pattern
n7e1e6d5dc49.x: The Second Plan stressed rapid industrialisation; the First focused on agriculture, irrigation and power, the Third on self-reliance and food self-sufficiency, and the Fifth on poverty removal.

o: All decisions are taken by one central authority
Decisions are distributed to lower governments or private units within a broad policy
The plan is revised every year and extended by one year
The plan covers a period of 15–20 years
n4fa7696e2cc.x: Decentralised planning distributes decision-making to lower governments or private units within a broad policy framework; centralised planning concentrates it in one authority.

o: A plan revised every year and extended by one year
Long-term planning over 15–20 years or more
Planning by binding orders of a central authority
Planning limited to the current financial year
n7d8ed393a50.x: Perspective planning covers 15–20 years or more; five-year and annual plans are carved out of it.

n7817b198b66.s: Under a rolling plan, the plan is:
o: Revised once at the end of five years
Kept fixed until the perspective plan ends
Revised every year and extended by one year
Revised every two years and extended by two years
n7817b198b66.x: A rolling plan is revised annually and extended forward by one year, giving flexibility in targets.

n6ece4204f43.s: According to the wage-goods model, the main constraint on economic expansion is the supply of:
o: Wage goods such as food and essential consumer goods
n6ece4204f43.x: The wage-goods model treats the supply of food and essential consumer goods, not capital goods, as the real constraint on expansion.

n8a86bcdf6e3.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Second Five-Year Plan is correctly matched?
o: Durgapur, Bhilai and Rourkela – Steel plants
n8a86bcdf6e3.x: The Second Plan left the Durgapur, Bhilai and Rourkela steel plants; Chittaranjan made locomotives and Perambur coaches.

o: State-led industrialisation with protection of infant industries
Marxist socialism with equal weight to agriculture and industry
Priority to heavy industry under the public sector
nc91ae5ee4e2.x: The People's Plan advocated Marxist socialism, stressed basic necessities and gave agriculture and industry equal weight.

nadda860f3ed.s: Which of the following pairs of Five-Year Plan and model is correctly matched?
nadda860f3ed.x: The Fourth Plan used the Allen Manne–Ashok Rudra model; the First was Harrod-Domar, the Third Sandy-Chakravarty and the Fifth the Dhar model.
